evidence.statement: A 25-bp exact block CCGCCTGGGGAGTACGGCCGCAAGG occurs five times in the frozen E. coli genome and once in the frozen Pyrococcus genome; no yeast occurrence was reported in the focus cluster.
Post-freeze annotation records that the first 16 bases CCGCCTGGGGAGTACG exactly match a published 16sF primer targeting 16S rRNA.
Treat this as a 16S-rRNA-associated conserved primitive, not as proof that the natural genomic sequence itself functions as a laboratory primer.

semantics.validation_note: First 16 bases match a published 16S-rRNA primer sequence.

unknowns: Specific molecular contribution of the full 25-bp sequence beyond its location in conserved 16S-rRNA-associated sequence.
